theorem: For an LR anchor N=A+Q+B with A<B, B<=20 and Q-(B-A)>20, no Leech bi-spider extends the anchor.
trust_boundary: Finite relaxed top-window exhaustion. Every possible endpoint of N-k for k<=20 is retained; all other vertices and the vertex budget are omitted. For Q>80, internal distances are at most 40 and cross-cluster distances have the form Q+c, so Q=81 has exactly the stable tail collision pattern.
